name: ogxo-statusline
description: Status line for Claude Code and Grok Build: model, context use, git branch and changes, session time, effort, output tokens, and session cost. Claude Code also shows thinking, prompt-cache state, and 5-hour, 7-day, and spend-limit bars. Grok Build uses the live context window, session output and cache-read share, and the active turn. /ogxo-statusline:setup writes Claude settings; /ogxo-statusline:setup-grok writes [ui.status_line] in the Grok user config. Requires jq.
